notes: neither … nor is one correlative pair on the waw: the clause's negative already holds not, so it is not a home for the opening word, and rule 14's limit reaches only a morpheme with no English of its own.
home born is headed on born; the competing reading heads it on home, but born carries the nativity that אֶזְרָח names.
הַתּוֹעֵבֹת הָאֵלֶּה leaves both articles unrepresented beside the written demonstrative, which is rule 29's own example.
